atoms.a: In 1955 a Black woman protested against the separation of Black people in public spaces. To find out more about this very important protest click the newspaper article.

instruction.text: Lies den Artikel und beantworte die Fragen.

hint.text: In the 1950s buses were segregated: Black passengers had to sit in the back and give up their seats for white riders if needed. This segregation was part of the Jim Crow Laws.
hint.label: Info

atoms.a: What did Rosa Parks do to get arrested?
b: She gave her seat to a white passenger.
++She refused to give her seat to a white passenger.
She did not ride the bus.
++The Black community did not use the bus system for one year.
++It was a peaceful protest against segregation.
Black people were not allowed to ride buses.

hint.text: Es gibt hier mehr als eine richtige Antwort.
hint.label: Info

atoms.a: What was the result of the boycott?
b: The bus segregation became even stricter.
white people were not allowed to ride the buses.
